blocks.text: This Meccan sûrah emphasizes that, unlike the evildoers mentioned in the *next sûrah, only those who take advantage of this fleeting life by doing good* will be successful in the eternal life to come.
In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful
except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance.
